youtube.title: DRS SARAH AND RANDALL FARRANT: The Brain’s Nightly Clean-Up — Why Deep Sleep Matters
youtube.summary: Rodney Hide speaks with Drs Sarah and Randall Farrant about the glymphatic system, the brain’s waste-clearance network and its role in maintaining neurological health. They explain how this process becomes more active during sleep and discuss the importance of sleep quality, movement, posture, hydration, nutrition and recovery. They also explore claims linking impaired drainage to neurological conditions and practical ways to support the body’s natural maintenance processes. For more information: Read the Farrants’ Blog post on the Glymphatic system Check out the Vital Wellbeing website , the Vital Wellbeing blog and Vital Wellbeing shop Follow Vital Wellbeing on Facebook , Instagram and Rumble

youtube.title: JEANNIE PATERSON: University of Melbourne Law Professor: AI’s Growing Power & Ethical Challenges
youtube.summary: Michael Arbon is joined by Professor Jeannie Paterson, Professor of Law at the University of Melbourne and co-director of the Centre for AI and Digital Ethics, to examine the rapid development of artificial intelligence and the challenges it presents. They discuss autonomous AI agents, legal accountability, the risk of another Robodebt-style failure, data privacy, digital duty of care and censorship, as well as the potential impact of AI on critical thinking and human relationships.
